title: Vinod Khosla: Seahawks' task is simple, keep winning and get another Super Bowl

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Vinod Khosla: Seahawks' task is simple, keep winning and get another Super Bowl
sources.description: Vinod Khosla, who was approved on Wednesday as the next owner of the Seattle Seahawks, says his expectation for the defending champions is more of the same.
